# elevenlabs Provider

Provider for the [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io) API. Manages ConvAI agents, workspace webhooks, and phone numbers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) ElevenLabs API key. Can also be set via the `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` environment variable.
